data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'l-th-f', meaning 'to hide' or 'to be gentle'. In Islamic tradition, Latheef represents the qualities of kindness, generosity, and tenderness. The name Latheef carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Latheef usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: لطيف
in_arabic.meaning: الله لطيف بعباده، رفيق، دلسوز، مهربان، نرم خو
in_arabic.long_meaning: لطيف من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الذي يلطف بعباده ويرفق بهم، ويعبر عن صفة لطفه ورفقه بعباده، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم 'وَاللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَأْتِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ'.

in_urdu.name: لطیف
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے بندوں کے ساتھ لطیف و نرم ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: لطیف اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے بندوں کے ساتھ بہت لطیف و نرم ہے، اور ان کے ساتھ بہت مہربان ہے، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: लतीफ

in_pashto.name: لطيف

in_english.name: Latheef
in_english.meaning: The one who is gentle, kind, and compassionate towards His servants
in_english.long_meaning: Latheef is one of the most beautiful names of Allah, signifying His gentle and kind nature towards His servants. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'L-T-F', it implies a sense of softness, subtlety, and benevolence. In the Quran, Allah describes Himself as 'Latheef' in Surah Hijr, 'And Allah is Latheef (gentle) with His servants.' This name reflects the attribute of Allah's mercy, compassion, and kindness to His creation.

This name is often given to children to encourage them to show warmth and tenderness not only to their loved ones but also to strangers and all those around them.
